description:
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing Hogaak.
If Hogaak is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Greater Good ability, causing you to draw eight cards and discard three cards.
Activate Zombie Infestation twice by discarding four cards, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five other cards from your graveyard and by tapping the two Zombies.
Repeat.
